This feature lets you extend a 4K video signal up to 100 meters (328 feet) over a single Cat6a/7 ethernet cable. It's the perfect solution for large venues, multiple rooms, or any setup where the source and display are far apart.

This feature lets you extend both IR (Infrared) and RS-232 control signals over the same single Cat6a/7 cable that carries your video and audio. Now you can easily manage your source devices (like a Blu-ray player or media server) from the display location, or control a distant display from your source.
